intent.responsibility: Own one reusable five-slot content row and its complete current configuration.
intent.visualBoundary: Resolve avatar, label and button slots through exact embedded Component boundaries.
intent.runtimeBehavior: Consume actor, label, sublabel and button state only through declared Runtime Inputs.
intent.forwarding: Forward values only through declared stable source and target identities.
intent.temporalOwnership: Keep slot Runtime Inputs relative to the Content Row owner.

component.name: Content Row
component.notes: Reusable five-slot row for module header, footer and main overlays.
